name: altheara
description: Altheara — the place where a life is kept.
//: overrides: pins ONE React across the workspace. Expo's packages declare `react: *` as a peer, so without this npm installs a second copy alongside the apps' own and Metro bundles both, which breaks hooks. 19.2.8 satisfies Next 16 (^19.0.0) and react-native 0.86.3 (^19.2.3). Bump the apps and this override together.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p packages/design && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile
